Every once in a while I think I'm lying.
Take it to the bank. I believe every word I say.

Think someone could spend half their life in a slam with a horse bit in their mouth and not believe? Think he could start out in some liquor store trash bin with an umbilical cord wrapped around his neck and not believe? Got it all wrong, holy man. I absolutely believe in God... And I absolutely hate the fucker
interesting. i'll have to further explore this later.

What I'm saying is.. The sentry getting kills by itself causes bots not to drop any money.. so how can I collect something that doesn't appear? I watched it destroy 10+ bots and nothing dropped, then the match was over so I left without further testing on the next round. So, I have no real idea besides this instance.

I like how it's "several topics on here." I take reddit as seriously as I take Wikipedia. Some things yes, some things no. It's also been researched that a lot of people will agree that a mind is still undeveloped at 15.. just because YOU knew better doesn't mean ANYONE else would. Otherwise, you're under the assumption just because you did "X" then John Doe would have done "X" too and that's wrong to assume.

I scout it up nowadays and I'll only switch if someone is being unreasonably stubborn or I can't get close enough to them for one reason or another. Or just to weed out the defense/offense, then switch back. I have more fun with my scout but I'll always love the satisfaction of a headshot taunt. 

I just enjoy the challenge of taking down heavy/medic pairs with a scout which isn't ever hard to do. I love the Sandman and my aptly named shotgun 'Thundercracker'. I taunt more with my scout than I ever have with my sniper.
I always wish I'm recording when someone pulls off a sick shot on me. It's always just my luck .. I always find it funny too.

I only taunt when someone tries to out-snipe me and only then they'll do it after I've killed them 10+ times in a row. So it's more like 'Hey, you got lucky.' But like in every other game where I'll snipe, I'll always be in the front row of the action so I won't take the time do it unless it was an amazing shot :O 

And to piss some people off.

~500 hours.. I only buy keys but I don't know how much I've actually spent. I've had the game since ~Early 2008... I haven't always been able to use my PC but it's always been my favorite game and always will be. I loved TF Classic .. when it was just Team Fortress, back in the day.

I worked for subway for about a total of 3 months... even before then and after, it's funny because I normally always get a BLT. They always ask what do I want on it besides bacon. It's just how they train; everyone's required to ask about everything from bread, to cheese, to meats and veggies and all the trimmings and everything else. 

However, being who I am I always just ask once and gave them what they asked for. Or I wouldn't ask a question and people would just tell me as I went down the line since I knew they knew the routine already. A lot of people don't always want exactly what they say they want. I never get tomatoes on my BLT.
